description: Buy-the-dip screen: strong 1y and 5y performers, not overpriced, that have pulled back mostly because the market did.

rules.name: strong_5y
rules.why: 5-year annualized total return at or above its benchmark index

rules.name: pe_reasonable
rules.why: trailing P/E positive and no higher than 35

rules.name: pe_below_hist
rules.why: trailing P/E at or below its own ~3-year median

rules.name: dipped
rules.why: at least 7% below its 52-week high, or down 3%+ over 30 days

rules.name: market_driven
rules.why: 30-day move not more than 5 pts worse than beta x index move (dip is mostly the market, not company news)
